resources.string: Describe a video. We write it, voice it and draw it.
Not configured. This build has no server address yet.
We couldn\'t sign you in. Please try again.
We linked your accounts but couldn\'t finish signing you in. Please tap the button once more.
By continuing you agree to the %1$s and %2$s.
Puts your photos in the order they were taken and groups them by day

Names the places in your story. An approximate location (about 1 km) is sent, never the exact spot, and it is not kept after your video is planned. Location is always removed from the photo files themselves.
Your photos are private to you. Only you can see them. Nobody at videomk browses them. They are used to find your photos and to make the videos you ask for. Delete any photo or everything, any time.
Ask offers after a big upload. Always groups photos by place and month, and adds later uploads to matching collections. Never leaves everything as it is.
Permanently deletes your account, your videos, your photos and My media, your credits and your sign-in. This can\'t be undone.
Your photos and everything in My media
Your credits, including any you have left
Your data is removed within minutes and your sign-in within about an hour or two. If you want to sign up again with the same email, please wait until then.
To make sure it\'s you, you may be asked to sign in again first.
Please wait. This takes a few seconds.
Opening the sign-in page in your browser. Sign in again there to confirm. Nothing is deleted until you do.
Sign in again in your browser to confirm it\'s you. Nothing is deleted until you do.
You signed in with Apple. To finish, confirm with Apple so videomk stops being connected to your Apple ID. This is optional and your account is deleted either way.
To finish, go to appleid.apple.com, sign in, open Sign-In and Security, then Sign in with Apple, choose videomk and select Stop using Apple ID.
Done: videomk no longer has access through your Apple ID.
We couldn\'t reach videomk, so we can\'t tell if the deletion started. Check your connection and try again. Trying again is safe.
Something went wrong on our side and nothing was deleted. Please try again.
This request doesn\'t match the account you are signed in to, so nothing was deleted. Sign out, sign in again and retry.
The confirmation wasn\'t accepted, so nothing was deleted. Check the word and try again.
You didn\'t finish signing in again, so nothing was deleted. You are still signed in.
We couldn\'t confirm it\'s you, so nothing was deleted. You are still signed in. Please try again.
You signed in with a different account, so nothing was deleted. Use the account you are deleting.
We still couldn\'t confirm a fresh sign-in, so nothing was deleted. Please try again. If it keeps failing, use the steps at videomk.com/delete-account.

resources.string: 1 credit makes up to 1 minute of video, rounded up: a 10-second video and a 60-second video cost 1 credit, a 61-second video costs 2. Free credits expire; credits you buy never do.
